transcript: My father brought home a small puppy Mother decided to adopt her And we named her Sora Sora looked anxious at first Father declared her a member of our family And we all welcomed her Mother found her gentle I considered her a good companion Within a few days She began to feel that our house belonged to her too I promised to protect Sora She trusted us in return Father said, let us accept this dog as family And we embraced her together After a few weeks, our care had made her a calm and contented dog Sora became the curious, affectionate heart of our home And she carried a warm bond into every heart

segments.text: My father brought home a small puppy
Father declared her a member of our family
I considered her a good companion
She began to feel that our house belonged to her too
Father said, let us accept this dog as family
After a few weeks, our care had made her a calm and contented dog
Sora became the curious, affectionate heart of our home
And she carried a warm bond into every heart
